text: Saturn is transiting the 1st sign from your birth Moon, read for the self, personal energy and the way the day is met. Treat it as a season for consolidating rather than launching, with steady daily habits.

rule: Sade Sati phase 1: Saturn in the 12th sign from the natal Moon (the opening two and a half years)
text: Phase 1 of Sade Sati: Saturn is in the 12th sign from the natal Moon, roughly the first two and a half years of the seven and a half. It is read for expenses, sleep, distant matters and the first lesson of the transit: what to release before the heavier middle phase. New commitments are kept light; old ones are cleared.

rule: Sade Sati phase 2: Saturn in the 1st sign from the natal Moon (the middle two and a half years)
text: Phase 2 of Sade Sati: Saturn is in the sign of the natal Moon itself, the middle two and a half years and classically the most demanding. It is read for pace that slows, responsibilities that feel personal and a mind that asks for routine. It is a season for consolidating what matters rather than launching what is new.

rule: Sade Sati phase 3: Saturn in the 2nd sign from the natal Moon (the closing two and a half years)
text: Phase 3 of Sade Sati: Saturn is in the 2nd sign from the natal Moon, the closing two and a half years. It is read for careful speech, family resources rebuilt slowly and the finishing of what the earlier phases began. The weight lifts gradually; what was learned under pressure tends to stay.
